title: Alsation Cabbage Galette
description: A traditional German-inspired galette filled with sautéed cabbage and onions, perfect as a side dish or light lunch.

ingredients.name: Cabbage
ingredients.notes: green or red, whichever is in season

instructions: Roll out galette pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add sliced onions and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally.
Add shredded cabbage and cook until tender, stirring occasionally.
Season with Chinese five-spice powder and stir to combine.
Brush the edges of the galette pastry with olive oil.
Spoon the cabbage mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling and press edges to seal.
Brush the top of the galette with olive oil and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
